fields.text: Text → Stable Audio 3 Small Music (`stable-audio-3/small/music/text-to-audio`) (~$0.024/gen). Instrumental alley score — not `sing` vocal Mureka song, not Night-ride SFX sting, not Mirelo foley.

Instrumental only — no vocals, no lyrics. Late-night neon alley score for a charcoal Volt pocket radio with a cyan lightning chevron: low trip-hop pulse, soft rain ticks, distant scooter wash once, quiet electrical hum. Dark, cool, cinematic bed under 90 seconds. No radio DJ talk, no crowd cheer.
